name: Data.diagonalPeriodForm_formRep
summary: Substitute x ↦ x·u in the integral over [U(V_{j,j})] (right invariance of the quotient measure); the block point moves accordingly, and rationality of the forms absorbs the rest.

steps.claim: The integrand at x of the translated pair is the integrand of (y, φ) at x·u (left to be shown), and the integral over the quotient is invariant under right translation by u (`Space.integral_comp_mul_right`), provided the integrand is left invariant under rational points (left to be shown) and continuous.
steps.lean:
refine (congrArg _ (funext fun x ↦ ?_)).trans ((gridSpace ..).integral_comp_mul_right u
    (fun a b x ↦ ?_) (y.2.1.rec (φ.2.1.rec (by fun_prop)))).1

steps.claim: The block point of x·u is the block point of x times that of (u, 1) (U.block is a homomorphism).
Left invariance: for rational b, y(b·x) = y(x) and φ(block(b, 1)·x) = φ(x) (automorphy of the forms, the block of a rational point being rational in Z_{j,j}: `Data.gridSpace_diag`).
steps.lean:
simp; rw [y.2.rat_mul _ b, ← one_mul (1, _), ← Prod.mk_mul_mk, map_mul, map_mul,
    mul_assoc, φ.2.rat_mul] <;> simp_all [gridSpace_diag h, mem_Γ_iff_range, Space.reindex,
    sum, ← map_inv, reindex_equiv (D.gridDiagEquiv j), -coe_units_inv, -RingHom.mem_range]
